newsitem.title: USA: Gateway Data sees Q1 loss $0.15-$0.20/shr.
newsitem.headline: Gateway Data sees Q1 loss $0.15-$0.20/shr.

text.p: Gateway Data Sciences Corp said Wednesday said it expects to report a loss per share in the range of $0.15 to $0.20 for the first quarter of its fiscal 1998, which ended today.
It said financial results for the period will fall short of analysts' projections.

It attributed the loss to lower than projected revenue, particularly in third-party products, consulting services as well as increased investments in software development and sales and marketing efforts.
It said it expects its software revenue to be up modestly from the fourth quarter of last year, although below both analyst projections and comparable period of a year ago.
Revenue from consulting services are expected to be also down from the fourth quarter and below analyst forecasts, although up very slightly from the similar period a year ago, it said.
Revenue from third-party products, although up from a weak comparable period from a year ago, is expecte to be well below fourth quarter levels and analysts projections, it said.
Operating expenses, meanwhile, are expected to be up significantly from both the fourth quarter last year and the comparable period a year ago, it said.

The increase is attributable primarily to higher software development expenditures, as the company accelerates development of software products, and increased sales and marketing expenditures, as the company expands sales capacity and market presence, it said.
Its cash position is expected to be up from the end of the prior quarter, it said.
It said it expects to release financial results for the first quarter during the first half of June.
